articles.abstract_en: We introduce a topological invariant of games, based on homotopy theory, that measures their complexity. We examine it in the context of the “Texas Hold'em” variant of poker, and show that the invariant's value is at least 4. We deduce that evaluating the strength of a pair of cards in Texas Hold'em is an intricate problem, and that even the notion of who is bluffing against whom is ill-defined in some situations. The use of higher topological methods to study intransitivity of multi-player games seems new.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种基于同伦理论的游戏拓扑不变量，用以衡量其复杂性。我们在“德州扑克”变体中对其进行了考察，并证明该不变量的值至少为4。我们由此推断，评估德州扑克中一对牌的实力是一个复杂的问题，且在某些情况下，甚至谁在向谁虚张声势的概念也是不明确的。使用更高阶的拓扑方法来研究多人游戏的非传递性似乎是新颖的。

articles.title_en: A maximal domain for weak stochastic dominance strategy-proofness of the extended probabilistic serial correspondence
articles.title_cn: 扩展概率序列对应的弱随机占优策略可证明性的最大域
articles.abstract_en: On the strict preference domain, Bogomolnaia and Moulin (2001) introduce the probabilistic serial rule and show that the rule is weakly stochastic dominance strategy-proof. Katta and Sethuraman (2006) introduce the extended probabilistic serial correspondence, which generalizes the probabilistic serial rule to the full preference domain. However, this correspondence is not weakly stochastic dominance strategy-proof. In this paper, we introduce a subdomain of the full preference domain, which we call “the sequentially ranked from the top domain,” on which the correspondence is weakly stochastic dominance strategy-proof. In fact, it is a maximal domain on which the three requirements of stochastic dominance efficiency, stochastic dominance envyfreeness, and weak stochastic dominance strategy-proofness are compatible. In addition, on this domain, we provide an axiomatic characterization of it by adapting its characterization on the full preference domain (Heo and Yılmaz, 2015).
articles.abstract_cn: 在严格偏好域上，Bogomolnaia和Moulin（2001）引入了概率序列规则，并证明该规则是弱随机占优策略可证明的。Katta和Sethuraman（2006）引入了扩展概率序列对应，它将概率序列规则推广到完全偏好域。然而，该对应并非弱随机占优策略可证明的。在本文中，我们引入了完全偏好域的一个子域，称之为“从顶部依次排序域”，在该域上该对应是弱随机占优策略可证明的。事实上，它是随机占优效率、随机占优无嫉妒性和弱随机占优策略可证明性这三个要求相容的最大域。此外，在该域上，我们通过调整其在完全偏好域上的特征化（Heo和Yılmaz，2015），提供了它的一个公理化特征化。

articles.title_en: A dynamic optimization approach to delegation with an application to volunteer contracts
articles.title_cn: 一种动态优化方法在委托问题中的应用：以志愿者合同为例
articles.abstract_en: We present a novel and tractable method that is widely applicable to general delegation problems. Every delegation set is equivalent to an incentive feasible mechanism. We characterize mechanisms with at most finitely many points of discontinuity and prove that the corresponding constrained problem is equivalent to a discrete-time, finite-horizon, dynamic optimization problem. This transformation makes the problem tractable: The dynamic problem is essentially a shortest-path problem that is amenable to different solution methods. By analyzing the dynamic problem, we show that restricting to mechanisms with at most finitely many points of discontinuity broadly entails no loss to the principal and identify a novel sufficient condition for such mechanisms to be optimal. We also provide a numerical method to find an approximately optimal mechanism. Lastly, we illustrate the results in a new delegation model of volunteer contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖且易于处理的方法，广泛适用于一般的委托问题。每个委托集合都等价于一个激励可行的机制。我们刻画了具有至多有限个不连续点的机制，并证明了相应的约束问题等价于一个离散时间、有限期限的动态优化问题。这一转换使得问题易于处理：动态问题本质上是一个最短路径问题，适用于不同的求解方法。通过分析动态问题，我们表明，限制在至多有限个不连续点的机制上，对委托人而言通常没有损失，并识别了一个新颖的充分条件，使得此类机制是最优的。我们还提供了一种数值方法来寻找近似最优的机制。最后，我们在一个新的志愿者合同委托模型中展示了这些结果。

articles.title_en: Information design in the principal-agent problem
articles.title_cn: 委托代理问题中的信息设计
articles.abstract_en: We study a variant of the principal-agent problem in which the principal does not directly observe the agent's effort outcome; rather, she gets a signal about the agent's action according to a variable information structure designed by a regulator. We consider both the case of a risk-neutral and of a risk-averse agent, focusing mainly on a setting with a limited liability assumption. We provide a clean characterization for implementability of actions and utility profiles by any information structure, which turns out to be simple thresholds on the utilities. We further study naturally-constrained information structures in which the signal emitted from any action is either the action itself or some actions nearby. We show that the worst implementable welfare deteriorates gracefully as the information structure becomes noisier. In a more general class of signaling constraints, we prove that deciding whether a certain action is implementable is NP-complete.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了委托代理问题的一个变体，其中委托人不能直接观察代理人的努力结果；相反，她根据监管者设计的可变信息结构获得关于代理人行为的信号。我们考虑了风险中性和风险厌恶的代理人两种情况，主要关注有限责任假设下的设定。我们提供了任何信息结构下行动和效用配置可实施性的清晰刻画，这表现为对效用的简单阈值。我们进一步研究了自然受限的信息结构，其中任何行动发出的信号要么是行动本身，要么是附近的一些行动。我们表明，随着信息结构变得更加嘈杂，最差可实施的福利会优雅地恶化。在更一般的信号约束类别中，我们证明了决定某个行动是否可实施是NP完全的。

articles.abstract_en: Most comparisons of preferences are instances of single-crossing dominance. We examine the lattice structure of single-crossing dominance, proving characterisation, existence and uniqueness results for minimum upper bounds of arbitrary sets of preferences. We apply these theorems to derive new comparative statics theorems for collective choice and under analyst uncertainty, and to characterise a general ‘maxmin’ class of uncertainty-averse preferences over Savage acts.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数偏好的比较都是单交叉支配的实例。我们考察了单交叉支配的格结构，证明了任意偏好集合的最小上界的刻画、存在性和唯一性结果。我们应用这些定理，为集体选择和分析者不确定性下的比较静态分析推导出新的定理，并刻画了Savage行为上的一般“最大最小”类不确定性厌恶偏好。

articles.title_en: The art of concession in General Lotto games
articles.title_cn: 一般Lotto博弈中的让步艺术
articles.abstract_en: Can intentionally decreasing one’s own competitive abilities provide strategic benefits in adversarial environments? We investigate whether a competitor can gain an advantage by conceding valuable assets to an opponent under a well studied framework known as General Lotto games. While intuition suggests this cannot be done, we demonstrate that concessions do offer strategic benefits when made correctly. We explore concessions in two settings: 1) General Lotto games, which depict 1-vs.-1 adversarial interactions, and 2) coalitional Lotto games, which depict two independent players competing against a common adversary (2-vs.-1) on non-overlapping contests. Our first result shows that conceding budgetary resources cannot be advantageous in either setting. However, we demonstrate that conceding valuable contests can be beneficial in the coalitional setting, characterizing optimal concessions when they exist. When both independent players in the coalitional setting have the option to concede, we characterize the Nash equilibria that emerge in this strategic scenario.
articles.abstract_cn: 在对抗性环境中，故意降低自身竞争能力能否带来战略优势？我们研究在一个被称为一般Lotto博弈的成熟框架下，竞争者是否可以通过向对手让步有价值的资产来获得优势。虽然直觉表明这不可能实现，但我们证明，当让步方式正确时，让步确实能带来战略优势。我们在两种情境下探讨让步：1）一般Lotto博弈，描述1对-1的对抗互动；以及2）联盟Lotto博弈，描述两个独立玩家在非重叠竞赛中对抗共同对手（2对-1）。我们的第一个结果表明，在任一情境下，让步预算资源都不具有优势。然而，我们证明在联盟情境下，让步有价值的竞赛可能是有益的，并刻画了存在时的最优让步。当联盟情境中的两个独立玩家都有让步选项时，我们刻画了这一战略情境中出现的纳什均衡。

articles.title_en: Pricing skewed assets in multi-asset experimental markets
articles.title_cn: 多资产实验市场中的偏态资产定价
articles.abstract_en: Using a series of laboratory experiments, this paper examines whether preferences for positively skewed assets, commonly observed in individual decision-making, persist in market settings where assets with both positive and negative skewness coexist. Results from a traditional BDM [Becker et al., 1964] task confirm a strong preference for positively skewed assets. However, this preference does not carry over to continuous double auction (CDA) markets with balanced endowments: market prices equalize, consistent with predictions from the capital asset pricing model (CAPM). More surprisingly, in CDA markets with unbalanced initial endowments, a price inversion arises in which the negatively skewed asset becomes more expensive. Robustness checks across trading formats, group sizes, and asset scopes confirm these patterns. The findings underscore how institutional features and initial endowments moderate the translation of behavioral preferences into market prices, challenging the external validity of individual-level skewness preferences in financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过一系列实验室实验，本文考察了在个体决策中常见的对正偏态资产的偏好，是否在正负偏态资产共存的市场环境中持续存在。传统的BDM [Becker等人，1964]任务结果确认了对正偏态资产的强烈偏好。然而，这种偏好并未延续到具有均衡禀赋的连续双向拍卖（CDA）市场中：市场价格趋于均衡，与资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的预测一致。更令人惊讶的是，在初始禀赋不均衡的CDA市场中，出现了价格反转，即负偏态资产变得更为昂贵。跨交易格式、群体规模和资产范围的稳健性检验证实了这些模式。研究结果强调了制度特征和初始禀赋如何调节行为偏好向市场价格的转化，挑战了金融市场中个体层面偏态偏好的外部有效性。

articles.title_en: Sequential creation of surplus and the Shapley value
articles.title_cn: 剩余的顺序创造与沙普利值
articles.abstract_en: We introduce the family of games with intertemporal externalities, where two disjoint sets of players play sequentially. Coalitions formed by the present players create worth today, but the way these players organize also affects the future: their partition imposes externalities that influence the worth of coalitions formed by future players. We adapt the classic Shapley axioms and explore their implications. They are not sufficient to uniquely determine a value. We propose two solution concepts based on interpreting the Shapley value as the players' expected contributions to coalitions: the one-coalition externality value and the naive value. Our main results show that adding a single axiom to the classical Shapley axioms yields a unique value: the one-coalition externality value arises adding a principle of equal treatment of direct and indirect contributions or an axiom on necessary players, while the naive value is characterized adding equal treatment of externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了具有跨期外部性的博弈族，其中两个不相交的玩家集合依次行动。当前玩家形成的联盟今天创造价值，但这些玩家的组织方式也影响未来：他们的划分施加了外部性，影响未来玩家形成的联盟的价值。我们调整了经典的沙普利公理并探讨其含义。这些公理不足以唯一确定一个值。我们提出了两个基于将沙普利值解释为玩家对联盟的预期贡献的解概念：单联盟外部性值和朴素值。我们的主要结果表明，在经典沙普利公理中添加单一公理即可得到唯一值：单联盟外部性值通过添加直接和间接贡献平等对待原则或关于必要玩家的公理而产生，而朴素值则通过添加外部性平等对待来刻画。

articles.title_en: Rankings-dependent preferences: A real goods matching experiment
articles.title_cn: 依赖排序的偏好：一项实物匹配实验
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether preferences for objects received via a matching mechanism are influenced by how highly agents rank them in their reported rank order list. We hypothesize that all else equal, agents receive greater utility for the same object when they rank it higher. The addition of rankings-dependent utility implies that it may not be a dominant strategy to submit truthful preferences to a strategyproof mechanism, and that non-strategyproof mechanisms that give more agents objects they report as higher ranked may increase market welfare. We test these hypotheses with a matching experiment in a strategyproof mechanism, the Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD), and a non-strategyproof mechanism, the Boston mechanism. A novel feature of our experimental design is that the objects allocated in the matching markets are real goods, which allows us to directly measure rankings-dependence by eliciting values for goods both inside and outside of the mechanism. The experimental results are mixed, with stronger evidence for rankings-dependence in the RSD treatment than the Boston treatment. We find no differences between the two mechanisms for the rates of truth-telling and the final welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了通过匹配机制获得的物品的偏好是否受到参与者在报告排序列表中对其排序高低的影响。我们假设在其他条件相同的情况下，当参与者将同一物品排得更高时，他们从中获得的效用更大。依赖排序的效用加入意味着，在策略证明机制中提交真实偏好可能不是占优策略，而给予更多参与者其报告为更高排名的物品的非策略证明机制可能提高市场福利。我们通过策略证明机制——随机序列独裁（RSD）和非策略证明机制——波士顿机制中的匹配实验来检验这些假设。我们实验设计的一个新颖特点是，匹配市场中分配的物品是实物，这使我们能够通过引出机制内外物品的价值来直接衡量排序依赖性。实验结果不一，RSD处理中排序依赖的证据比波士顿处理更强。我们发现两种机制在真实报告率和最终福利方面没有差异。

articles.title_en: Robust implementation with peer mechanisms and evidence
articles.title_cn: 基于同伴机制与证据的稳健实施
articles.abstract_en: A principal must allocate a prize without monetary transfers. She wants to give it to the highest value agent. Agents know their own and their neighbors’ values, as determined by a network. Competing for the prize, agents send messages about themselves (applications) and their neighbors (references). They face a limit to lying, so information is partially verifiable. No incentive-compatible mechanism achieves robust implementation. Assigning the prize as a function of best applications and worst references achieves dominant strategy implementation for all networks and full implementation for the complete network and a class of networks if agents are partially honest.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人必须在不进行货币转移的情况下分配奖品。她希望将奖品给予价值最高的代理人。代理人知道自己的价值以及邻居的价值，这由网络决定。为了竞争奖品，代理人发送关于自己（申请）和邻居（推荐）的信息。他们面临说谎的限制，因此信息是部分可验证的。没有激励相容的机制能够实现稳健实施。将奖品分配作为最佳申请和最差推荐的函数，对于所有网络都能实现占优策略实施，对于完全网络和一类网络，如果代理人是部分诚实的，则能实现完全实施。

articles.title_en: Merging-splitting-proofness in financial systems: A characterization result
articles.title_cn: 金融系统中的合并-拆分免疫性：一个特征化结果
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we explore the issue of manipulability in the setting of financial systems by considering two weak forms of immunity: merging-proofness and splitting-proofness. Not surprisingly, splitting-proofness conflicts with basic requirements such as the priority of debt over equity and the limited liability of equity. Remarkably, we provide a comprehensive characterization of the class of bankruptcy rules that gives rise to financial rules that satisfy merging-proofness.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们通过考虑两种弱形式的免疫性——合并免疫性和拆分免疫性——来探讨金融系统中的可操纵性问题。不出所料，拆分免疫性与基本要求（如债务优先于股权和股权的有限责任）相冲突。值得注意的是，我们提供了破产规则类别的全面特征化，这些规则产生的金融规则满足合并免疫性。

articles.title_en: Indignation and the evolution of cooperation norms
articles.title_cn: 愤慨与合作规范的演化
articles.abstract_en: Sociologists and psychologists have long argued that emotions are essential to sustaining social norms. This study examines the role of indignation in upholding cooperation norms within society. I model indignation in a population psychological game and characterize the stochastically stable equilibrium in a noisy best-reply dynamic. The analysis yields two findings. First, indignation can sustain cooperation in the long run, irrespective of whether interactions are global or occur within a fixed local interaction structure. Second, mobility allows individuals to sort into cooperative communities, causing these communities to grow in size and persist under a wider range of conditions. Therefore, mobility fosters stable norms of cooperation and punishment in large human societies. This study is the first to apply stochastic stability to address multiple equilibria in psychological games.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会学家和心理学家长期以来一直认为，情感对于维持社会规范至关重要。本研究探讨了愤慨在维护社会合作规范中的作用。我在一个群体心理博弈中建模愤慨，并在噪声最佳回应动态中刻画随机稳定均衡。分析得出两个发现。首先，愤慨可以在长期内维持合作，无论互动是全球性的还是发生在固定的局部互动结构中。其次，流动性允许个体分类进入合作社区，导致这些社区规模增长，并在更广泛的条件下持续存在。因此，流动性促进了大型人类社会中合作与惩罚的稳定规范。本研究首次应用随机稳定性来解决心理博弈中的多重均衡问题。

articles.abstract_en: We introduce the notion of preconvexity, which extends the familiar concept of convexity found in cooperative games with transferable utility. In a convex game, the larger the group joined by an agent, the larger the marginal value brought to the group by that agent. By contrast, in strictly preconvex games, an agent’s marginal contribution is initially decreasing (when joining small groups), and it eventually becomes increasing at (and above) some critical group size. As a consequence, the core of a preconvex game may be empty. Defining the property of semicohesiveness (related to marginal contributions at this critical group size), we prove that it is sufficient to guarantee a nonempty core. We also propose a new solution for the set of preconvex games; and we characterize this solution by combining three axioms which are natural in our framework. A stronger cohesiveness property (guaranteeing that our solution falls in the core) is also studied. Some additional results are provided for the special case of anticonvex games, for which marginal contributions are always non-increasing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了预凸性的概念，它扩展了在具有可转移效用的合作博弈中常见的凸性概念。在凸博弈中，一个代理人加入的群体越大，该代理人给群体带来的边际价值就越大。相比之下，在严格预凸博弈中，代理人的边际贡献最初是递减的（当加入小群体时），最终在某个临界群体规模处（及以上）变为递增。因此，预凸博弈的核心可能为空。我们定义了半内聚性（与在该临界群体规模处的边际贡献相关）的性质，并证明它足以保证非空核心。我们还为预凸博弈集合提出了一种新的解；并通过结合我们框架中自然的三个公理来刻画这一解。还研究了一个更强的内聚性性质（保证我们的解落在核心内）。对于反凸博弈的特殊情况，我们提供了一些额外结果，其中边际贡献总是非递增的。

articles.title_en: Non-manipulable house exchange under (minimum) equilibrium prices
articles.title_cn: （最低）均衡价格下的不可操纵房屋交换
articles.abstract_en: We consider a market with indivisible objects, called houses, and monetary transfers. Each house is initially occupied by one agent and each agent demands exactly one house. The problem is to identify the complete set of direct allocation mechanisms that can be used to reallocate the houses among the agents. On the one hand, for price eq1uilibrium mechanisms, we show that the only non-manipulable mechanism is one with a minimum equilibrium price vector. The result is not true on the classic or the quasi-linear domains, but on reduced domains of preference profiles containing “almost all” profiles in the classic or the quasi-linear domain, respectively. On the other hand, while minimum price equilibrium mechanisms are not necessarily efficient (as prices are not zero), we show that no non-manipulable mechanism Pareto dominates a minimum price equilibrium mechanism, making them constrained efficient in the class of non-manipulable mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个包含不可分割物品（称为房屋）和货币转移的市场。每栋房屋最初由一位代理人占用，且每位代理人恰好需求一栋房屋。问题是确定可用于在代理人之间重新分配房屋的完整直接分配机制集合。一方面，对于价格均衡机制，我们表明唯一不可操纵的机制是采用最低均衡价格向量的机制。这一结果在经典域或拟线性域上不成立，但在分别包含经典域或拟线性域中“几乎所有”偏好的缩减偏好域上成立。另一方面，虽然最低价格均衡机制不一定有效率（因为价格不为零），但我们表明没有任何不可操纵机制帕累托优于最低价格均衡机制，使其在不可操纵机制类别中成为受约束的有效机制。

articles.title_en: Group incentive-compatible allocation of discrete resources when ownership is partitioned
articles.title_cn: 所有权分割时离散资源的群体激励相容配置
articles.abstract_en: We introduce the problem of allocating objects when society is partitioned into groups of agents, each collectively owning a number of objects equal to its size. We propose a new axiom, called “within-group endowments lower bounds”, which requires that each agent find his assignment at least as desirable as his least preferred object among those owned by the group to which he belongs. We identify and characterize a family of rules satisfying this axiom in addition to efficiency, group strategy-proofness, and group-wise neutrality. We also consider two core notions, the “standard core” and the “exclusion core” (Balbuzanov and Kotowski, 2019). Our finding is that they are independent notions, unlike in traditional ownership structures (e.g., collective, private, and mixed ownership), and that our proposed rules always recommend allocations in their intersection.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了当社会被划分为若干代理人群体、每个群体集体拥有与其规模相等的物品数量时的物品配置问题。我们提出一个新的公理，称为“群体内禀赋下界”，要求每个代理人认为其分配结果至少与其所属群体所拥有的物品中他最不偏好的物品一样好。我们识别并刻画了一族满足该公理以及效率、群体策略证明性和群体中立性的规则。我们还考虑了两种核心概念，即“标准核心”和“排斥核心”（Balbuzanov和Kotowski，2019）。我们的发现是，与传统所有权结构（如集体、私人和混合所有权）不同，这两个概念是相互独立的，并且我们提出的规则总是推荐位于它们交集处的配置。

articles.title_en: Exact Nash-like solutions of blockchain gap games
articles.title_cn: 区块链间隙博弈的精确纳什类解
articles.abstract_en: This note challenges the belief that mining processes are too complex for traditional game-theoretic analysis. We provide Nash-like equilibrium solutions for two-player gap games, focusing on the strategic delay of mining rig activation in Bitcoin’s Proof-of-Work (PoW) system. By delaying activation, miners can optimize profits, particularly as transaction fees become a more significant portion of their revenues (Carlsten et al., 2016). Building on the game-theoretic model of Tsabary and Eyal (2018), we offer a rigorous, proof-based analysis of this behavior, highlighting the importance of verifying simulation results through precise mathematical methods. The primary technical contribution of this note is a novel method for deriving closed-form equilibrium solutions for potentially non-differentiable ex-ante expected payoff functions Ui, defined as integrals in which the integrands—representing profit at time t—depend discontinuously on miners’ rig start times s.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文质疑了挖矿过程过于复杂而无法进行传统博弈论分析的观点。我们为两人间隙博弈提供了纳什类均衡解，重点关注比特币工作量证明（PoW）系统中矿机启动的战略性延迟。通过延迟启动，矿工可以优化利润，尤其是在交易费用占其收入比重越来越大时（Carlsten等，2016）。基于Tsabary和Eyal（2018）的博弈论模型，我们提供了对这种行为的严格、基于证明的分析，强调了通过精确数学方法验证模拟结果的重要性。本文的主要技术贡献是一种新颖的方法，用于推导可能不可微的事前预期收益函数Ui的闭式均衡解，这些函数定义为积分，其中被积函数——代表时间t的利润——不连续地依赖于矿工的启动时间s。
